answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Issuance tied to graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 12 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 260 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. A new key's first epochs pay a trickle, however many keys the farm holds. The ember test is the live device, the nadir test is the locked stake, and the island test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
